description: List company crews for discovery, newest first. Filter by comma-separated status values or use activeOnly=true to find crews that are still running, paused, or waiting for review. Returns one page, { items, hasMore, nextCursor }, of 25 crews unless you pass limit (max 200). Each item is a summary row: id, url, the first line of the task, status, stage, funding, token spend, initiative, PR and a halt or error reason capped at 200 characters; never the chat or snapshots (use anyforge_get_crew for one crew). While `hasMore` is true, call again with the same filters plus `cursor: nextCursor` for the next page.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Send it with the same status and activeOnly.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses such as RUNNING, PAUSED, or HALTED.

name: anyforge_list_crews
title: List crews
